reason: 111 anchors are hand-written f-string <a href=...> against 129 link() calls, so ~46% of anchors bypass link()'s escaping, and the relative prefixes are spelled out by hand at 48 sites. Add _area_link/_item_link/_creature_link beside the existing _script_link/_conv_link and route the call sites through them. Routing an anchor through link() can only change bytes where a name needed escaping, so any diff must be an escaped character inside an anchor.
